coverage_note: This screen's momentum_12_1 (and momentum_12_7/momentum_6_1) use exact calendar month-end prices with the skip month(s) excluded. The main research score's momentum_12_1 (pipeline/risk_metrics.py) instead uses a fixed 252/21-trading-day offset with no calendar anchoring. The two are both standard constructions of 12-1 momentum and can disagree slightly for the same ticker on the same day, particularly around holidays or short months -- a difference in convention, not an error in either one.
